C-TOOLBAR-LABELS.IntentSummary: Add panel-local visited-label state through shared vnode event hooks, retaining labels between button hovers and clearing them on whole-panel exit.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Real-pointer tests fail on the old table/diagram label behavior in both engines. The table-toolbar-labels file runs within the existing webkit-tables CI project, covering tables, Mermaid and Vega-Lite without changing workflow gates.

T-002.Title: Share cumulative label reveal and panel-exit reset

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Visited button labels remain open without cross-panel state or global listeners; panel exit resets them. Keyboard and disabled/hidden behavior stay intact.

T-003.Title: Verify, protect and prepare one fresh native acceptance artifact

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Both-engine toolbar/footer/viewer regressions, required GRACE checks and protected integration/CI are recorded accurately. The fresh app visibly presents wide-table and diagram controls for review.
